item.title: The impact of self-driving cars on the rideshare industry
item.description: While driverless rideshare options aren’t available in Tucson yet, the option to take a ride without a driver is available in a handful of cities across the country.

item.title: Sheriff says detectives still have more to work with in Guthrie kidnapping
item.description: Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos says fewer people are involved in the day to day search for Nancy Guthrie but it is still an active, aggressive search and he is still optimistic she will be found.

item.title: Amphi School District Board Member not seeking re-election after elementary closures
item.description: Matt Kopec, vice president of the AUSD Governing Board, is not seeking re-election after 8years on the board, after a year of school closures driven by declining enrollment and budget concerns.
